system.description:
You may make a [Normal Move] up to your [Speed] Sq. During this Main Process, [Dodge Checks] made in opposition to your attacks take a -1D penalty.

(Minor): Increase the distance moved by +1 Sq.

A special ability to move with a stable gait that does not shake even on a ship that is rocking by the waves. It is difficult to dodge a blow that is delivered from a sure foot.
